scene: You climb the iron ladder up onto the bakery's breezy gravel rooftop.
picture: Flat side view along the rooftop ground line. On the left lies a glowing glass skylight. Center shows a wooden pigeon roost with a roosting pigeon. The tall Latino player in his teal jacket and messenger bag stands right of center. On the far right, a wooden hanging footbridge extends outward.
shown: a square glass skylight glowing with bakery light, located on the left
a wooden pigeon coop with a roosting carrier pigeon, sitting in the centre
a narrow wooden suspension bridge swaying slightly on the far right

variants.scene: The gravel rooftop smells of sweet warm bread beneath a quiet twilight sky.
Cool evening air surrounds the bakery roof as city stars begin to shine.
You reach the rooftop, still humming {tune} above the quiet city streets.
